mapper.sql: SELECT r.id, r.version, r.account, a.id account_id, a.account_name, a.account_icon, a.account_type, r.other_account, oa.id other_account_id, oa.account_name other_account_name, oa.account_icon other_account_icon, oa.account_type other_account_type, r.type, c.id type_id, c.type_parent_id, c.type_icon, c.type_name, c.type_difference, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, r.remark, r.pay_time, r.images, r.money, r.client_uuid, r.del_flag, r.commemoration_day_id, cd.id commemoration_id, cd.name commemoration_name, cd.date commemoration_date FROM px_bookkeeping_record r LEFT JOIN px_bookkeeping_classification c ON r.type = c.id LEFT JOIN px_bookkeeping_account a ON r.account = a.id LEFT JOIN px_bookkeeping_account oa ON r.other_account = oa.id LEFT JOIN px_commemoration_day cd ON r.commemoration_day_id = cd.id AND cd.del_flag = 0
mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(r.pay_time, '%Y年%m月%d日') AS 日期, c.type_name AS 分类, CASE c.type_difference WHEN '0' THEN '收入' WHEN '1' THEN '支出' WHEN '2' THEN '转账' WHEN '3' THEN '账户调整' ELSE '未知' END AS 类型, a.account_name AS 账户, r.money AS 金额, r.remark AS 备注 FROM px_bookkeeping_record r LEFT JOIN px_bookkeeping_classification c ON r.type = c.id LEFT JOIN px_bookkeeping_account a ON r.account = a.id WHERE r.del_flag = 0 AND c.del_flag = 0 AND r.type != 0 AND r.create_by = #{createBy} AND DATE_FORMAT(r.pay_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(#{payTime}, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY r.pay_time ASC;
